column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
a failed run whose log cannot be read is refused, not briefed
a gate run that completed without failing is nothing to repair, and one that failed without a log is refused
and none of them is handed on as a brief
and passes on npm's own reason
and says the install failed rather than ending in silence
and says the log could not be read
